name: czrecoilframe_destructor
description: CZRecoilFrame::Destructor restores the Recoil frame vtable, destroys the owned menu member through the MFC provider path, resets the menu base vtable, and tears down the CZGameFrame base.
known_limits: No VC COFF byte target covers 0x430610 yet; the source uses the repo MFC42 provider helper for CMenu::DestroyMenu while preserving the observable member teardown order.

The native smoke constructs the CZGameFrame base, installs a real menu handle, calls CZRecoilFrame::Destructor, and verifies that the menu member leaves the constructed menu-vtable state after DestroyMenu/reset teardown.
